title: The Aeroplane, 19 Mar 1948, p.338: lift curves and profile drag graphs (Figs. 21-22)
description: Magazine page with "Fig. 21.—Lift curves of aerofoils of different aspect ratios", two plots of lift coefficient against angle of incidence from 1920 Goettingen wind-tunnel results, and "Fig. 22.—Increase of profile drag with section thickness, at zero lift" comparing square and rounded tips. Text discusses Zimmermann's work with Chance-Vought, the V-173 and XF5U-1, under the heading "The Real Flying Saucer?".
